objective: sum over customers of priority * (lateness_penalty * lateness + window_violation_penalty * (early_start + late_start) + unfilled_job_penalty * unfilled)

capacity_min.description: Most minutes of service plus travel in the day; used only if the technician is dispatched
capacity_min.label: daily working capacity (min)

depot.description: Location the technician leaves from and returns to
depot.label: home depot

priority.description: Weight on every penalty of a job of this type
priority.label: job priority

qualified.description: 1 if the technician can do jobs of this type
qualified.label: qualified flag

location.description: Town of the job; one customer per location
location.label: customer location

due_time.description: Time the job should be finished by; later finish is lateness
due_time.label: due time

travel_min.description: Driving time, same in both directions (one row per pair)
travel_min.label: travel time (min)

day_length_min.description: Every service starts between 0 and this time; also the big-M base of the sequencing rows
day_length_min.label: working day length (min)

unfilled_job_penalty.description: Penalty for a job nobody is assigned to
unfilled_job_penalty.label: penalty per unfilled job

window_violation_penalty.description: Penalty per minute a service starts outside its window
window_violation_penalty.label: penalty per minute outside the time window

lateness_penalty.description: Penalty per minute a job finishes after its due time
lateness_penalty.label: penalty per minute late

decision_variables.route[from_location, to_location, techni: binary, technician drives this leg (legs touching another technician's depot fixed to 0)

constraints.cover[customer]: sum over qualified technicians of assign + unfilled = 1
constraints.one_technician[customer]: sum over all technicians of assign <= 1
constraints.capacity[technician]: duration of assigned jobs + travel of driven legs <= capacity_min * use
constraints.arrive[technician, customer]: legs into the customer's location = assign
constraints.leave[technician, customer]: legs out of the customer's location = assign
constraints.return_depot[technician]: legs from customer locations into the home depot = use
constraints.leave_depot[technician]: legs from the home depot to customer locations = use
constraints.sequence[customer, customer]: if any technician drives a to b: start b >= start a + duration a + travel (big-M)
constraints.from_depot[depot, customer]: if any technician drives depot to b: start b >= start at depot + travel (big-M)
